rationale: Selected for founder-accessible, part-time, AI- and data-leveraged validation across eight distinct structures: installer-embedded finance, clinic-run validation, customs decision support, qualified reusable-asset rental, reserved laboratory capacity, registry-confirmed retirement, parcel refund recovery, and payment-dispute recovery. Delayed-memory calibration excluded direct repeats in white-certificate origination, grid-site options, flexibility aggregation, EUDR plot evidence, deposit reconciliation, and freight detention. Each retained candidate depends on a concrete channel, permission, asset, capacity slot, registry event, or recovered transaction; its unproven partner and rights gates remain explicit research questions.
